n4165ac6175.headline: Brothers disappear along with £2.5billion worth of Bitcoin in alleged heist
n4165ac6175.summary: South African nationals Ameer and Raees Cajee, operators of Africrypt, are under investigation by crypto lawyers following an alleged $2.5 billion Bitcoin theft.
n4165ac6175.why: Africrypt was a major crypto investment platform in South Africa; such a large-scale alleged theft raises regulatory and investor confidence concerns in crypto markets.
